content:
iOS 27 will be rolled out to all users next week, and the first iOS 27.1 beta and official version will arrive shortly after. Here is the expected release time for iOS 27.1.

iOS 27.1 will be released in October, when the iPhone Duo will also be launched, with the beta version expected to arrive in about a week.

If you haven't been using Apple's beta testing version yet, remember that there will be a major iPhone system update next week.

iOS 27 will officially launch this Monday (September 14), featuring new functions including Siri AI.

However, if you've been using iOS 27 beta all summer, you may have already started looking forward to iOS 27.1.

Apple is expected to release the first iOS 27.1 beta within about a week after iOS 27 is launched. Here are the relevant records in recent years:

  • iOS 26.1 beta was released 7 days after iOS 26 launched
  • iOS 17.1 beta was released 9 days after iOS 17 launched
  • iOS 16.1 beta was released 2 days after iOS 16 launched

I'm not counting iOS 18, because Apple released the 18.1 beta earlier that summer specifically to test Apple Intelligence features.

Following the past pattern, iOS 27.1 beta 1 may arrive as early as next week, or at the latest within the week of September 21.

So when is the official version?

Apple confirmed this week that iOS 27.1 will be released on or before October 23, and the actual date may even be a few days earlier.

Its iPhone Duo press release stated: "iPhone Duo will launch with iOS 27.1." Since iPhone Duo won't reach users until October 23, the system update must be released on or before that day.

This timing is actually slightly earlier than usual. Counting from 2025, Apple's x.1 version updates in the past four years were released on November 3, October 28, October 25, and October 24 respectively.

Based on the timing that iOS 27.1 needs to launch alongside iPhone Duo, this system's official release date is most likely between October 19 (Monday) and October 21 (Wednesday).

Besides the exclusive features for iPhone Duo, the contents of this update are currently unknown. We'll update everyone once the first beta is released.
